name: UniSQ Student Financial Loans
summary: Short-term interest-free loans for enrolled UniSQ students who have no other way to borrow.
key: Interest-free loans up to $1000 for continuing students, repayable within 12 months.
who: Enrolled in a current teaching period
Has exhausted all other ways to get a loan
how: Fill out the Student Financial Loan Application Form and book an appointment with a Student Advisor (Wellbeing)
catches: First-trimester students can borrow up to $500, repayable within 6 months
All loans are immediately repayable if you stop being enrolled

evidence.quote: Continuing students (with satisfactory academic progress): Interest-free loans up to $1000, repayable within 12 months.
First-year, first-trimester students: Interest-free loans up to $500, repayable within 6 months.
The student must have exhausted all other avenues to obtain a loan and a student loan is the only option.
